🔥 **THANK YOU Chinese Embassy in Manila for the brutal truth bomb that exposes Philippine elite hypocrisy!** 🔥

President Marcos Jr. is OPEN to resuming joint oil & gas discussions with China — the kind of pragmatic move that could finally bring down our crushing fuel and power prices. But Stratbase Albert del Rosario Institute (co-chaired by oligarch Manny Pangilinan) “firmly rejects” any such proposals? 😂 What a convenient stance.

Who is really making foreign policy in the Philippines? The elected President or a private think tank backed by the same elites?

During the **Duterte era**, while the hardliners screamed “sovereignty,” pragmatic steps were taken: the 2018 PH-China Memorandum of Understanding on oil and gas cooperation was signed, and **PNOC** (Philippine National Oil Company) was positioned for service contracts allowing third-party participation, including potential collaboration with Chinese firms under Philippine law. Duterte even lifted exploration moratoriums to get energy flowing for Filipinos instead of endless talk.

But now? Pangilinan’s empire (PLDT, Meralco, etc.) benefits from sky-high electricity rates while his own Stratbase blocks the very joint development path that was on the table before. **Pangilinan’s PXP Energy controls the dominant stake in SC-72 (Recto Bank / Reed Bank)** — located in the West Philippine Sea, west of Palawan Island and southwest of the Malampaya Gas Field — yet his think tank rejects cooperation. Classic oligarch hedge: Razon wisely walked away from his 30% stake years ago rather than join questionable JV pushes, but the pattern remains — protect the monopoly, keep US security guarantees flowing, and let ordinary Pinoys suffer at the pump (₱135+/L diesel, anyone?).

Inset **retired Justice Antonio Carpio** — the uncompromising architect of the 2016 arbitral victory. He warns any joint deal could be a “trap” if it implies Chinese ownership of resources, and his hardline voice feeds the same Stratbase/del Rosario ecosystem that prioritizes legal purity over actual energy for the people.

Layer on the US-Philippines Society (USPS) network + Loida Nicolas Lewis, deeply aligned with US-Democrat circles, pushing the “rules-based order” narrative. Add PCG’s Jay Tarriela, AFP’s Col. Francel Margareth Padilla, **Rear Admiral Roy Vincent Trinidad** (AFP Spokesperson for the West Philippine Sea and Philippine Navy’s key voice), and the rest of the Stratbase-aligned crew — all flooding the airwaves with every gray-zone incident, turning drama into daily headlines. Great for clicks and narrative control, disastrous for energy security and affordability.

Who benefits from rejecting joint exploration? The same oligarchs and their US-aligned backers who dominate power distribution and thrive on high prices.  
Who bears the brunt of soaring fuel prices? Every tricycle driver, jeepney operator, family, and business struggling daily.

Chinese Embassy hit the nail on the head: **Keep up the good job calling out Stratbase’s double standards!** Filipinos are waking up. We don’t need more rejection letters from elite think tanks. We need real energy solutions — like the PNOC service contract approach that was seriously on the table during Duterte — to power the nation, not endless geopolitical posturing and Washington influence games.

Cheaper fuel and gas for Pinoys NOW. Enough with the hedge that keeps us poor while the powerful stay comfortable. 🇵🇭💪🔥

#JointExplorationPH #PNOCServiceContract #DutertePragmatism #StopOligarchHedge #FuelPricesKillingUs
